name: Aescin (oral)
className: Venoactive (aescin); no UK licensed or registered aescin product

availability.note: No UK product information for aescin (escin) tablets. Searched 2026-10-17: emc search for aescin and escin (no results); MHRA Products index by product name and full text for aescin, escin and horse chestnut. The only UK product is a Traditional Herbal Registration (THR 13668/0010) for gastro-resistant tablets of horse chestnut seed dry extract (MHRA substance: Aesculus hippocastanum dry extract 4-6:1), each equal to 50 mg triterpene glycosides calculated as beta-aescin. Its active substance is the whole herbal extract, not aescin, so it is a different active substance from the clinic products (aescin 50 mg tablets; aescin 20 mg tablets listed as aescine salicylate) and was not used. Not filled from non-UK labels.
